part.text: The dataset has complete Brooklyn records from 2013 through 2025; 2026 is partial, so I’ll exclude it. I’m using annual pedestrian injury counts and annual pedestrian deaths as separate measures: they show different parts of safety, while the data has no walking-exposure denominator to estimate individual risk.

input.command:
python -c $'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

out = Path("out")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
data = duckdb.connect().execute("""
    SELECT year(crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured)::INTEGER AS pedestrian_injured,
           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::INTEGER AS pedestrian_killed
    FROM read_parquet(?)
    WHERE borough = 'BROOKLYN'
      AND crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
""", ["data/crashes.parquet"]).df()

series = [
    (1, "pedestrian_injured", "Pedestrians injured", "Pedestrians injured in reported Brooklyn crashes", "Injuries", "#176B87"),
    (2, "pedestrian_killed", "Pedestrians killed", "Pedestrians killed in reported Brooklyn crashes", "Deaths", "#B6423C"),
]
for oid, col, label, title, ylabel, color in series:
    values = data[["year", col]].rename(columns={col: "count"})
    values.to_csv(out / f"values_{oid}.csv", index=False)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 5.6), layout="constrained")
    ax.plot(values.year, values["count"], color=color, linewidth=3, marker="o", markersize=6)
    ax.fill_between(values.year, values["count"], 0, color=color, alpha=0.10)
    ax.set_title(title + " | 2013–2025", loc="left", fontsize=17, weight="bold", pad=15)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlabel("Year", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xticks(values.year)
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#D9DEE3", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#AAB2B8")
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0, pad=7)
    start = int(values.iloc[0]["count"]); end = int(values.iloc[-1]["count"])
    change = (end / start - 1) * 100
    direction = "down" if change < 0 else "up"
    ax.annotate(f"{start:,}", (2013, start), xytext=(0, 12), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", color=color, weight="bold", fontsize=10)
    ax.annotate(f"{end:,}\n{abs(change):.0f}% {direction} vs. 2013", (2025, end), xytext=(-5, 12 if end >= start else -36), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", color=color, weight="bold", fontsize=10)
    fig.text(0.01, 0.005, "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes; Brooklyn crash location. Annual counts, not adjusted for walking volume.", fontsize=8.5, color="#4A5560")
    fig.savefig(out / f"option_{oid}.png", dpi=180, facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
print(data.to_string(index=False))'
